parts.name: discord
parts.description: The Discord plugin — the REST calls each step makes, the invite URL and permission bits, rate-limit retries, the gateway receiver (heartbeat, identify, resume, close codes, fatal faults), its normalization and addressing rules, and its mock REST routes and fake gateway socket.

parts.name: platforms
parts.description: The BotPlatformPlugin interface and the rules every plugin follows (session fetch, deadlines, authenticate, normalize, receiver and fatal faults); how to add a platform without touching the core; the mock transport, mock calls with `auth`, simulate's path and botMockHelper. Each platform's API calls are its own part (telegram, whatsapp, discord, slack).

parts.name: slack
parts.description: The Slack plugin — the Web API calls each step makes, the signing-secret signature and url_verification handshake, the admin user token for delete, emoji names, 429 retries, its normalization, dedupe key and addressing rules, and its mock workspace, signed inbound and challenge.

parts.name: telegram
parts.description: The Telegram plugin — the Bot API calls each step makes (getMe, setWebhook, getUpdates, sendMessage, deleteMessage, restrictChatMember, banChatMember, setMessageReaction), its secret-token hook, its fatal codes, its normalization and addressing rules, and privacy mode in groups.

parts.name: whatsapp
parts.description: The WhatsApp plugin — the Cloud API calls each step makes, the verify-token handshake and app-secret signature, manual setup and the one-callback-per-app rule, its normalization, its mock (phone number ids, wamids, signed inbound, challenge) and the unused per-number callback override.
